teach.narration_en: Tanween doubles a vowel sign and adds an 'n' sound: ً fathatan (an), ٌ dammatan (un), ٍ kasratan (in). You'll see it on the very last letter of a word — كِتَابٌ ends in -un, بَيْتًا ends in -an, بَابٍ ends in -in. It only shows up word-finally, so for now just learn to spot the three shapes — you'll read them aloud for real once we start reading full ayat.
teach.focus_en: Tanween = doubled vowel + n sound, always at a word's end.
